title: DG3 - Preservation / Monotonic Inheritance
claim: A valid higher layer preserves the valid capabilities of the lower layer it depends on while adding a new capability class.
assumptions: A higher layer cannot depend on a lower layer while abolishing the valid structure that makes the dependence possible.
definitions: Preserves(L2, L1): L2 retains the valid capability structure of L1 inside its own layer.
Monotonic inheritance: higher layers inherit and add rather than erase and replace.
negative_guards: Do not use theology to abolish valid physics.
Do not use physics to abolish valid logic or lived-reality data.
Do not confuse contextualizing a lower layer with invalidating it.
kill_conditions: A valid derivation step depends on a prior layer while denying the valid capability it requires.
Preservation cannot be formalized well enough to test.
